_readme: Paths to the other CEC systems ON THIS MACHINE. If a path doesn't exist here, the matching Hub page just says 'not connected' — nothing breaks. Use double backslashes in paths. On Mark's dev machine the Optomate agent lives at C:\Claude\Claude Code\CEC-Optomate-Agent — swap the C:\CEC paths below if you're setting the Hub up there.

optomate_agent._agent_dir_note: Root of the Optomate agent. The Recalls and Check-in tiles run its engines from here (python -m recall... / python -m checkin.cli ...).

second_brain._dir_note: Root of the Second Brain clone on this machine. The Scanner page reads tools\scanner-card\scanner-card.partial.html out of it on every page load, so `git pull` there is the whole update: no copy, no restart. On the practice server the clone is at C:\Users\ConcordeyecareServer\Claude\cec-second-brain.

checkin._staff_code_note: What each front-desk computer types once to unlock Check-in (6+ characters). Never type it on the iPad. While this is the placeholder, Check-in works only on the server itself. Changing it locks every computer out again.
checkin._note: The reception iPad's device key. Make one with:  python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))"  then open http://<server>:5680/checkin/ipad#<the key> on the iPad and Add to Home Screen (README, 'iPad setup'). Every iPad call must carry it; while this is the placeholder (or shorter than 16 characters) the iPad shows 'Not set up yet'. Changing it locks out the old iPad link.
